module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Print products that need reordering, sorted by stock level.

import std.json
import std.filesystem
import std.environment
import std.console

public type Product
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer where stock is at least 0
  has reorder_level: Integer where reorder_level is at least 0
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, filesystem.read, environment
  purpose: Read products from a JSON file and print those below reorder level.

  let args be environment.arguments()
  let path be args.first() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "No file path provided")
  
  let json_text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "Cannot read file")
  let products_data be json.parse(json_text) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "Invalid JSON")
  
  let products be parse_products(products_data) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "Invalid product data")
  
  let needs_reorder be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock ascending
    collect product
  
  for each product in needs_reorder
    console.print("{product.name}: {product.stock} units (reorder at {product.reorder_level})")
  end
end

function parse_products(data) returns List of Product or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Convert parsed JSON into a list of Product objects.
  
  match data
    when success(value) then
      let items be value otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Not a list")
      let result be []
      for each item in items
        let product be parse_product(item) otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Invalid product")
        set result to result.append(product)
      end
      return result
    when failure(error) then
      fail with ParseError(detail: error.to_text())
  end
end

function parse_product(item) returns Product or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Convert a JSON object into a Product.
  example: parse_product({"name": "Widget", "stock": 5, "reorder_level": 10}) is Product(name: "Widget", stock: 5, reorder_level: 10)
  
  let name be item.get("name") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Missing name")
  let stock_val be item.get("stock") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Missing stock")
  let reorder_val be item.get("reorder_level") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Missing reorder_level")
  
  let stock be stock_val.to_integer() otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Invalid stock")
  let reorder_level be reorder_val.to_integer() otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "Invalid reorder_level")
  
  return Product(name: name, stock: stock, reorder_level: reorder_level)
end

public type AppError
  has detail: Text
end

public type ParseError
  has detail: Text
end

module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Print products that need reordering, sorted by stock level.

import std.json
import std.filesystem as files
import std.environment as env
import std.console

public type Product
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer where stock is at least 0
  has reorder_level: Integer where reorder_level is at least 0
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, filesystem.read
  purpose: Read products from JSON and print those below reorder level.

  let args be env.arguments()
  let path be
    if args.length is at least 1 then
      args.first() otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "no arguments")
    otherwise
      fail with AppError(detail: "no file path provided")
    end
  end

  let text be files.read_text(path) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "cannot read file")
  let json_value be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid JSON")
  let products be parse_products(json_value) otherwise fail with AppError(detail: "invalid product format")

  let low_stock be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock ascending
    collect product
  end

  for each product in low_stock
    console.print("{product.name}: {product.stock} in stock (reorder at {product.reorder_level})")
  end
end

function parse_products(value) returns List of Product or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Extract products from a JSON value.

  match value
    when json.Array(items) then
      let result be []
      for each item in items
        let product be parse_product(item) otherwise fail
        set result to result.append(product)
      end
      return result
    otherwise
      fail with ParseError(detail: "expected array")
    end
  end
end

function parse_product(value) returns Product or fails with ParseError
  purpose: Extract a single product from a JSON object.

  match value
    when json.Object(fields) then
      let name be fields.get("name") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "missing name")
      let stock_val be fields.get("stock") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "missing stock")
      let reorder_val be fields.get("reorder_level") otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "missing reorder_level")

      let name_text be
        match name
          when json.String(text) then text
          otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "name must be string")
        end
      end

      let stock_num be
        match stock_val
          when json.Number(num) then num.to_integer() otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "stock must be integer")
          otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "stock must be number")
        end
      end

      let reorder_num be
        match reorder_val
          when json.Number(num) then num.to_integer() otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "reorder_level must be integer")
          otherwise fail with ParseError(detail: "reorder_level must be number")
        end
      end

      return Product(name: name_text, stock: stock_num, reorder_level: reorder_num)
    otherwise
      fail with ParseError(detail: "expected object")
    end
  end
end

public type AppError
  has detail: Text
end

public type ParseError
  has detail: Text
end
